description: A project's progress and insights (GET /projects/:id/insights), counted like the portal's panel: per task list done of total (people's tasks), open issues by list (open / acknowledged / in progress, 30 days; an archived, completed or demo project counts none unless demo=true), and the newest 20 activity items (completions, scans, issues) with who and when. Read tier.

demo.description: Count a demo / test project's open issues too (default false)
